for the Respondent Nos.11,2,3,4,4.1,4.2,4.3,4.4,4.5,4.6 MR KRITIK PARIKH, AGP ON ADVANCE COPY SERVED TO GOVERNMENT PLEADER for the Respondent No.1.

 CORAM:HONOURABLE THE ACTING CHIEF JUSTICE MR.
 JUSTICE A. J. DESAI  and  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE BIREN VAISHNAV  Date : 11/07/2023  ORAL ORDER (PER : HONOURABLE THE ACTING CHIEF JUSTICE MR.
JUSTICE A. J. DESAI)
1.
We have heard Mr. Tejas P. Satta, learned advocate appearing for the petitioners and Mr. Kritik Parikh, learned AGP appearing for the respondent No.1.

We have also gone through the impugned order passed by the Competent Authority & Land Acquisition Officer, Surat as well as gone through the application under Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 filed by the petitioners.

2. It is the case of the petitioners that through oversight and bonafide mistake, the correct revenue numbers of the land belonged to the petitioners have not been reflected in the award passed by the Competent Authority.
It is also the case of the petitioners that they have never requested for reference.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In view of the above facts, we dispose of the present petition with following directions :-
(I) It would be open for the petitioners to file an appropriate application for modification of the award as well as file an application under Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 for appropriate compensation before the appropriate authority.

(II) If such an application is filed within a period of four weeks from today, the concerned Authority shall decide the same in accordance with law and shall do the needful after verifying the original revenue records.
It is made clear that this Court has not examined the merits of the case.
